Filing Lens

Cited answers from company filings, from a local 3B model (Qwen 2.5, runs on the phone)

Retail investors are handed 100-page 10-Ks. Chatbots answer anyway, with no page reference, and the filing gets uploaded to someone else's server.

FinanceBench (Islam et al., 2023, arXiv:2311.11944): GPT-4-Turbo with a retrieval system incorrectly answered or refused 81% of 150 open-book filing questions.

Problem: wrong answers look the same as right ones, and privacy is the price of asking.

Privacy proof

The document never leaves the device. The build's e2e test enforces this; it isn't just claimed.

Requests during upload → index → ask → abstain20
to any host other than the app's own origin0
carrying a request body (POST/PUT/beacon)0
  • pdf.js, MiniLM embeddings, ONNX runtime, wllama: npm packages served from the app origin, no external scripts
  • Index + PDF stored in IndexedDB
  • Only third-party fetch: the Qwen2.5 weights (GET, once, then cached). Airplane mode after that: [ASK: confirm on phone]

Architecture: a two-stage cascade

PDF→pdf.js page text→page-bounded chunks→MiniLM embeddings→IndexedDB
Question→hybrid retrieval
dense + BM25, k=8, ≤3000 tok→① feature gate
12 features → LR ÷ T
0.41 ms→② DSPy verifier on the 3B
ANSWER / ABSTAIN + evidence page→DSPy cited answer
Qwen2.5-3B, WebGPU→[p.N] check
p < 0.5 → abstain, 3B never runsverdict ABSTAIN → abstaincitation outside snippets → abstain

① is cheap and catches wrong-company questions (it scores retrieval and word coverage, not content). ② reads the actual sentences: it is a DSPy program, shipped uncompiled for now (0 demos; the Kaggle compile with BootstrapFewShot, 2 demos, is pending), exported to app/prompts/verifier.json and rebuilt in the browser byte-for-byte. A unit test checks this against DSPy's own rendering. In the cascade, 53% of test questions reach ②.

Bench: gate vs verifier vs cascade

FinanceBench open-source (patronus-ai/financebench), 150 questions, 84 filings. Gold answer = question on its own filing; Easy abstain = another company's 10-K; Hard abstain = own filing with the gold pages removed. Test split (company-grouped), 165 instances.

SystemEasy acc.Hard acc.ECE E / HCite pagep503B calls
Feature gate only0.8640.5180.191 / 0.1570.279*0.41 ms0%
Verifier only (DSPy-compiled 3B)pending (Kaggle)100%
Cascade: gate → verifierpending (Kaggle)53%

* gate proposes no page: top-ranked retrieved page. Gate p50 measured in Node on Node v22.22.0, 4 vCPU container, no GPU; verifier p50 will come from the Kaggle T4 GGUF Q4 build.

Gate, all 450 out-of-fold: Easy acc 0.867, abstain P/R 0.813 / 0.953; Hard acc 0.517. Two "does the top passage answer this?" features: Hard 0.513 → 0.517.

Limits (measured)

  • The feature gate can't see content: Hard 0.518 (chance is 0.5). It scores retrieval and word overlap, so "the gold page" and "a nearby page about the same metric" look alike. The verifier stage exists for that case; its numbers are pending the Kaggle run.
  • Retrieval is the bottleneck: gold-page recall@4 0.440, @8 0.633, @12 0.700. With the 3k-token cap the 3B sees the gold page 57% of the time; the sentence snippets keep it 53%.
  • A failure I shipped and fixed: Best Buy's 10-K never mentions Walmart, yet "Walmart capex?" scored 0.69 and passed the first gate. Adding a feature for whether the companies a question names appear in the filing at all fixed it (gate accuracy 0.82 → 0.91 on the earlier own-vs-wrong-company bench).
  • Answers are auto-graded (number within 1%, else token-F1), an approximation of FinanceBench's human grading. Scanned PDFs (no text layer) are rejected.

Roadmap

  • Run the Kaggle compile; ship the compiled verifier and report verifier / cascade numbers on the GGUF Q4 build
  • Retrieval: table-aware chunking for financial statements; a reranker only if one ships as an npm package (none found) and adds <150 ms
  • Raise the context budget if the phone allows (uncapped k=8 prompts reach 3586 tokens)
  • Indian filings: BSE/NSE annual reports, Hindi questions
